dataset_cache_limitation: The replay selector uses four prompts per class as its working set, but the process retains the full local 15k training rows/cache; this is not a physically bounded 4-per-class learner.
interpretation: Do not pool k=1 and k=10 same-sample metrics: each is a separate fixed objective/budget condition, although both use the corrected objective tag.
Gold CE reuses known old/current training labels and exposes more labeled targets than sampled Sleep; equal event/update counts do not match information or FLOPs.
A single seed is exploratory. Endpoint changes cannot identify a pure optimizer-step effect apart from extra sampled sequences, forwards, and gold-label exposure.
The earlier historical k=1 run used a different edit proxy and is not substituted for the corrected k=1 arm.
